locks.HANDS: Hands relaxed with natural knuckle creases and veins; five fingers each, fingers not touching the face during speech.
locks.BEHAVIOUR: They blink naturally, glance away to think, restart a gesture, adjust a sleeve, take a breath before a line, and finish with a small involuntary nod. (Write gestures, never emotions.)
locks.AUDIO-CLOSE: Dialogue: only the quoted line(s), spoken by [PERSON] at the stated seconds, in natural British English; lips still when not speaking; no other voices. No background music. No subtitles. At least 1 second of ambience-only before the first word and after the last word.

videos.duration_target: 75 s master at 16:9; 45 s cut at 9:16
videos.concept: A Warwick taxi owner, parked up before sunrise, tells us in his own words what it was like when Google sent no work his way, what changed, and what's different now. Problem (his own car, pre-dawn) → turn (his own back office, laptop open with a green screen; at about 38 s the live footer credit 'Made with ❤ by Hulk Marketing Ltd' is pushed in as proof of the work) → result (the first data receipt lands at 49 s, 65% of the runtime, pushed from his laptop into full frame). The series motif opens and closes it: a phone lighting up face-up on a dark dashboard, its screen never readable. He quotes no numbers: the numbers are ours, on screen and sourced. Golden Line is the only client with a verified Hulk footer credit and an attributed Search Console screenshot.
videos.hook: 16:9: black; a wiper thunks once; a phone lights up face-up on a dark dashboard and buzzes against the plastic (BR01); over it, the first sentence of his real answer about the early runs; no title for 6 s. 9:16 cut: the same image with the totals receipt (312 clicks · 18.2K times shown) on screen by 0.8 s.
